day_shape: 99 items: Hezbollah rejects US-mediated Lebanon ceasefire as IDF kills engineering-unit chief Abed Harb and an IDF captain dies from anti-tank fire, CENTCOM reports 127 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, Trump says no deal needed for Iran's uranium.

threads.label: Lebanon ceasefire collapses, cross-border strikes
threads.summary: Netanyahu told the Security Cabinet there is no ceasefire deal after Hezbollah rejected the US-mediated proposal, with IDF strikes, evacuation warnings and rocket and drone fire continuing across southern Lebanon. The IDF announced killing Hezbollah engineering-unit commander Abed Harb, while Captain Eitan Shmuel Lemberg, 21, was killed by an anti-tank missile north of the Litani.

threads.label: UNIFIL casualty and UN statements
threads.summary: A Serbian UNIFIL peacekeeper died from wounds after mortar shells hit his position near Marjayoun, the seventh peacekeeper killed in Lebanon since March, drawing a Secretary-General condemnation. Guterres separately called for Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon, while Defa Press said Hezbollah denied Israeli accusations of a resistance role in the UNIFIL attack.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and uranium posture
threads.summary: Trump said Washington did not need a deal with Iran to obtain its enriched uranium, calling it "entombed," while Iran International reported stalled talks and warnings of renewed unrest from moderates. Khamenei's office released messages claiming the US and Israel had been dealt a "decisive blow" and describing hybrid warfare targeting resilience and officials' "computational system."

threads.label: US blockade and Iran trade workarounds
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS McFaul continues to support the US blockade against Iran, with forces having redirected 127 commercial vessels, disabled six non-compliant ships and allowed 36 humanitarian vessels through as of June 4. Iran International reported Iraq's Umm Qasr emerging as a hub for Iran-bound cargo more than 50 days into the blockade, while CBI data showed services imports surging to $25.5 billion.

threads.label: Gaza strikes on Hamas security apparatus
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said overnight air and naval strikes in Gaza killed senior Hamas General Security Apparatus members including deputy head Hassan Labad, Asim Shubair, Abdullah Abu Kaloub and Mohammed Abu Marek, with nine Palestinians reported dead. The Jerusalem Post reported security officials' concern that Hamas is exploiting a power vacuum in Gaza to re-establish control.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy around Iran's nuclear file
threads.summary: IRIB reported a joint meeting of Iranian, Chinese and Russian ambassadors with IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi to review items for the upcoming Board of Governors meeting. Secretary Rubio met Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Sheikh Jarrah Al-Sabah, while Defa Press quoted Foreign Minister Araghchi saying Iran had warned regional states that US bases would be "legitimate targets."

threads.label: Iran hardliner pressure and ICBM demands
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited reformist outlet Asriran reporting Iranian officials sent a letter to Mojtaba Khamenei demanding the Islamic Republic begin developing ICBMs. Iran International reported hardliners pushing escalation after the most serious recent US-Iran exchange, while Defa Press carried a former IRGC intelligence deputy saying America "only understands the language of force."

events.title: An explosive-laden first-person view (FPV) drone launched by Hezbollah struck near IDF Northern Command chief Maj. Gen. Rafi Milo, who was visiting southern Lebanon several weeks ago, according to the military. The IDF says that "no damage was caused and there were no casualties" in the incident, although reports indicate that the drone hit one of the vehicles in Milo's convoy shortly after he exited his car. Since the incident, the IDF has changed its protocols for visits of officers to southern Lebanon.
events.summary:

Since the incident, the IDF has changed its protocols for visits of officers to southern Lebanon.— Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian (@manniefabian) Jun 4, 2026
